note: The East End: from Lawrenceville (LB, 40th & Butler) up Stanton Avenue over Stanton Heights to Highland Park and round the reservoir, down N Highland Ave to East Liberty, Shady Ave and Beechwood Blvd past Mellon Park and Bakery Square to Squirrel Hill, and Forbes Ave to Schenley Park (K). Portals: LB (the Allegheny & Troy Hill), K (Oakland & Schenley). Junction ids may be two letters (LB, HE, HP, EL, SQ): edge keys are FROM>TO with any ids.

nodes.name: Highland Park: Bunkerhill St & One Wild Place

Penn Ave & Shady Ave, East Liberty

LB>HE.rev: Mellon Terrace and down N Negley Ave, Stanton Ave up over Stanton Heights and the long descent to Butler Street

HE>HP.name: N Highland Avenue: the park entrance

HE>HP.rev: up N Highland Ave to the Highland Park entrance garden and Bunkerhill St to the zoo gates

HP>HE.name: Highland Park Reservoir & Lake Drive
HP>HE.fwd: Stanton Ave along the park, Lake Drive past Lake Carnegie and round the reservoir to the zoo gates
HP>HE.rev: past the zoo gates, Lake Drive round the reservoir and Lake Carnegie, down Stanton Ave to N Highland

HP>EL.name: N Highland Avenue: East Liberty
HP>EL.fwd: down N Highland Ave into East Liberty and Penn Ave to Shady
HP>EL.rev: Penn Ave and up N Highland Ave to Stanton

EL>SQ.name: Bakery Square & Beechwood Boulevard
EL>SQ.fwd: Penn Ave past Bakery Square, Fifth to Beechwood Blvd and up past Mellon Park to Forbes
EL>SQ.rev: Forbes Ave to Beechwood Blvd, down past Mellon Park to Fifth, Penn Ave past Bakery Square to Shady

SQ>EL.name: Shady Avenue

SQ>EL.rev: Shady Ave over Fifth past Mellon Park and up into Squirrel Hill to Forbes

SQ>K.name: Forbes Avenue: Squirrel Hill

SQ>K.rev: Forbes Ave out of Schenley Park through Squirrel Hill past Murray Ave to Shady
